text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired -> incident PD-4821: canary error rate > 5% on /v1/generate (release-2026.03.14-canary)

alice (eng-oncall): acked the pager, looking now. Can anyone confirm if traffic was shifted for the canary?

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty incident PD-4821 created and routed to eng-oncall. Escalation policy: canary-oncall -> sre-lead.

bryan (sre): on it. Pulling logs from canary pods and LB. Looks like 502s from inference runtime after the new kernels landed.

alice (eng-oncall): noted. grabbing pod list and recent events.

alice (eng-oncall): ```
kubectl -n prod get pods -l app=inference-canary
kubectl -n prod logs inference-canary-7b9f -c inference | tail -n 200
```

datadog-alerts: [Monitor] canary /v1/generate error rate >5% for 5m - https://app.datadog.example/monitors/2345 (auto-mute: false)

carla (pm): tagging in — what's customer impact? Any external 5xxs? Customer reported latency spikes a few minutes ago.

bryan (sre): yes, 502s to some customers hitting the new canary. Traffic is only 10% but error surge visible in prod->front proxies. Link: https://dashboards.example/canary-error-rate (short window shows spike).

alice (eng-oncall): I'm seeing stack traces pointing to attention kernel selection failing on sequence lengths >1024 in the new build. Suspect regression introduced in model runtime optimization.

dmitri (platform): FYI I see increased OOMs in the canary node pool around the same timestamps. Could be memory regression in the new image.

bryan (sre): good catch. If it's memory/kvcache sizing, we should rollback canary image to last stable. Suggest rollback of rollout to release-2026.03.13.

carla (pm): agree. We need to minimize customer impact. Do rollback and keep us posted. I'll notify CS for any inbound tickets.

alice (eng-oncall): initiating rollback now. ```
# rollback canary to previous image
kubectl -n prod set image deployment/inference-canary inference=registry.redwood/release-2026.03.13
kubectl -n prod rollout status deployment/inference-canary
```

deploy-bot: Rollout command received for deployment/inference-canary. Starting image update to registry.redwood/release-2026.03.13.

bryan (sre): monitoring pods come up. Watching error rate.

incident-bot: PD-4821 acknowledged by alice (eng-oncall). Escalation timer paused.

alice (eng-oncall): errors trending down. 5xxs dropped from ~6.4% -> 1.1% after new pods stabilized. Still watching for 10m.

dmitri (platform): nodes show memory back to normal. No OOM reports after rollback.

carla (pm): TY. Carla -> notifying CS and a small "we're aware" notice for affected customers. Keep updates short.

bryan (sre): re-run smoke tests against canary endpoint. ```
curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate -d '{"input":"hello"}' | jq .status
```

alice (eng-oncall): smoke ok, latency and errors within baseline.

deploy-bot: Rollout completed successfully for deployment/inference-canary -> image: release-2026.03.13.

incident-bot: PagerDuty PD-4821 set to resolved (auto-resolve condition met).

alice (eng-oncall): marking incident as mitigated. I'll hand off the follow-up to bryan for postmortem and regression root cause. I'm going to update the incident channel with timeline + logs in ~30m.

bryan (sre): taking postmortem ownership. Scheduling RCA sync for 10:30 PT and will include model/runtime owners + infra.

carla (pm): can we gate the canary rollout while root cause is investigated? Hold any traffic shifts for the next release until we get a fix.

dmitri (platform): will add rollout hold on release-2026.03.15 and revert any auto-promote.

alice (eng-oncall): handing off on-call to bryan in 15m. If anything regresses before then I'll re-alert.

bryan (sre): acknowledged handoff. I'll keep monitor dashboards on and paging policy tightened for the next 4h.

carla (pm): thanks everyone. Postmortem and action items expected in the RCA doc. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Reminder — add incident tag: canary-deploy, regression, rollback. Postmortem owner: bryan (sre).
